title: Powers of elements of a finite purely inseparable algebra lie in the base after localization
statement: Let $A'$ be a Noetherian integral domain with fraction field $K'$, and let $E$ be a finite $A'$-algebra [pqf-lem-finite-integral-lft] that is a domain with fraction field $L$. Assume that $L/K'$ is finite purely inseparable [def-pc-field-extension] [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]. There is a nonzero $s\in A'$ such that, writing $A''=A'[1/s]$ and $E''=E\otimes_{A'}A''$, the following hold: if $K'$ has characteristic $0$, then $E''=A''$; if $K'$ has characteristic $p>0$, then for every $x\in E''$ there is an $n\ge 0$ with $x^{p^n}$ in the image of $A''$.
